timing_scope: memory source image and supplied ROI to PIL; includes cache setup, correction, cleanup, encode, all DiT, scheduler, decode; excludes model load, static table preparation, PNG, metrics, precomputed region plan

static_correction_tables.timestep_conversion: Cast scheduler timestep to model dtype, then divide by 1000, matching pipeline input
static_correction_tables.objective: Diagonal-covariance frozen-centered-feature MSE plus lambda_s*(a-1)^2 for each output channel
static_correction_tables.rho_definition: Square root of summed predicted centered Value residual variance divided by summed target variance; surrogate diagnostic only
static_correction_tables.schedule_contract: Reuse only with identical frozen fused weights, dtype, device, statistics and exact eight model timesteps; caller verifies scheduler
static_correction_tables.inference_cost: No extra token projection; eager per-token channel coefficient gathers add bandwidth and temporary memory
static_correction_tables.interpretation: Per-output-channel attention Value approximation; does not recover hidden drift, stale K or general cross-channel covariance; no quality claim
static_correction_tables.provenance_responsibility: Caller supplies and verifies source hashes, calibration-only data and image-level split
static_correction_tables.statistic_semantics: Target img_norm1 output before modulation; population variance, not post-modulation features
static_correction_tables.timestep_statistics_semantics: For pair (t,s), the same frozen h=mean_s+xi_s is used at both timesteps with diagonal Var(xi_s)=variance_s; anchor mean and variance only

timestep_contract_instrumentation: Eight tiny device clones in all configurations; compare actual model time inputs after request timing, no extra model forward
